import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RMEquiv254
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.NativeTheory254

#print axioms RMEquiv254.wf254
#print axioms RMEquiv254.path_halts_iff_iter
#print axioms RMEquiv254.path_halts_iff

-- Every initial register vector, not only a finite tested prefix.
example (R : RMDag.Regs) :
    RegisterPath.Halts RMEquiv254.pathDag254 ⟨[], R⟩ ↔
      RMDag.IterHalts Dag254.dag254 R :=
  RMEquiv254.path_halts_iff_iter R

-- The actual native theory endpoint composes at the path-DAG layer.
example : RegisterPath.Halts RMEquiv254.pathDag254
      ⟨[], RMDag.upd (fun _ => 0) 0 2⟩ ↔
      BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot :=
  RMEquiv254.path_halts_iff.trans NativeTheory254.c254_refutation_iff

-- The proved one-way ZF0 comparison reaches this path program.
example (hf : BProv PSCCalibration.ZF0Ax [] Form.fBot) :
    RegisterPath.Halts RMEquiv254.pathDag254 ⟨[], RMDag.upd (fun _ => 0) 0 2⟩ :=
  RMEquiv254.path_halts_iff.mpr (QuotientZF0.c254_of_zf0_refutation hf)
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
